newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan demonstrators call CIA shooter a hero.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan demonstrators call CIA shooter a hero.

text.p: About 5,000 people marched through the Pakistani town of Quetta on Tuesday hailing as a hero a man accused of a deadly 1993 shooting spree outside CIA headquarters in the United States.

Mir Aimal Kansi, 33, was taken to the Washington area last week to face charges of killing two CIA workers and wounding three but the Pakistani government has been accused of waiving proper extradition proceedures in the case.
"Aimal is our hero", chanted the demonstrators in Quetta, the capital of Baluchistan, Kansi's home province.

Pakistan's main human rights group has filed a petition before the provincial high court to challenge Kansi's arrest, one of a series of challenges in the courts to the decision to send the suspect to the U.S.

A joint statement by Pakistan Bar Council, the national organisation of the legal profession, and the Lahore High Court Bar Assocaition called for the return of Kansi to Pakistan and trial by a home court.

Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's government has still not explained the arrest of Kansi, a native of Baluchistan, since it was announced on June 17 by the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) in Washington.
